text: In October 2017, the Board of Directors of Build Toronto approved the sale of 253 Markham Avenue and 12, 20 and 30 Dunelm Street to Options for Homes and authorized Build Toronto Management to enter into a purchase and sale agreement which reflected the terms and conditions contained in the Confidential Property Sale Submission. In December 2017 the Board of Directors approved an amendment to the purchase and sale agreement. Subsequent to this time the City introduced its Development Charge by law which increased development charges by approximately 90% and the Province of Ontario eliminated its Investment in Affordable Housing program. Due to the substantial financial impact of these two measures, management is recommending a further amendment to the purchase and sale agreement as outlined in the confidential attachments to this report.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 6, 2018) from the Head, Development, CreateTO and the Head, Legal and Corporate Secretary, CreateTO. 2. Authorized and directed CreateTO management on behalf of Build Toronto to execute any agreements, transfers, consents and other documents required to amend the purchase and sale agreement in accordance with the confidential instructions to staff set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 6, 2018) from the Head, Development, CreateTO and the Head, Legal and Corporate Secretary, CreateTO. 3.
